cards.audioText: Your call sign is CSN6202, destination Harbin. You just departed from Beijing airport at 23. You are passing 1200m and want to climb to 1800m, contact Beijing Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是南航6202，目的地哈尔滨。北京机场起飞的时间是23分。刚刚飞过1200米，想爬升到1800米，联系北京离场。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, CSN6202, from Beijing to Harbin, airborne 23, passing 1200m, request climb to 1800m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，南航6202，北京飞哈尔滨，离地时间23分，过1200米，请求上1800米。

cards.audioText: CSN6202, Beijing Departure, radar contact, due to slower preceding traffic, cancel SID, turn right heading 010.
cards.audioTextZh: 南航6202，北京离场，雷达已识别，由于前机减速，取消SID，右转航向010。
cards.referenceText: Cancel SID, turn right heading 010, CSN6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 取消SID，右转航向010，南航6202。

cards.audioText: CSN6202, climb to 5400m on standard, resume own navigation, direct to YV via flight planned route.
cards.audioTextZh: 南航6202，上升标压5400米，自主领航，按计划航路直飞YV。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 5400m on standard, direct to YV via flight planned route, CSN6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升标压5400米，按计划航路直飞YV，南航6202。

cards.audioText: Inform the controller that your weather radar shows a build-up around YV, request direct to KAKAT.
cards.audioTextZh: 通知管制员你的气象雷达显示YV处有积雨云，请求直飞KAKAT。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, CSN6202, radar indicates a CB around YV, request direct to KAKAT.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，南航6202，雷达显示YV附近有积雨云，请求直飞KAKAT。

cards.audioText: CSN6202, contact Beijing Control 125.9 for request.
cards.audioTextZh: 南航6202，联系北京区调125.9，请求直飞。

cards.audioText: Make an initial contact with Beijing Control, 5400m maintaining, request direct to KAKAT due to weather.
cards.audioTextZh: 开始联系北京区调，保持5400米，由于天气原因，请求直飞KAKAT。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN6202, 5400m maintaining, request direct to KAKAT due weather.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，南航6202，保持5400米，由于天气原因，请求直飞KAKAT。

cards.audioText: CSN6202, climb to and maintain 10700m. Due Air Force restriction, suggest heading 020. [Because the CB is too large, you want heading 030.]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航6202，上升并保持10700米。由于空军限制，建议航向020。【由于积雨云范围太大，你想要航向030。】
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 10700m, request heading 030 due CB, CSN6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升并保持10700米，由于积雨云，请求航向030，南航6202。

cards.audioText: CSN6202, turn right heading 030 approved.
cards.audioTextZh: 南航6202，同意右转航向030。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 030, CSN6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向030，南航6202。

cards.audioText: Now you have cleared weather, back on course.
cards.audioTextZh: 【天气转好，返回航道。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN6202, cleared weather, back on course.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，南航6202，天气转好，返回航道。

cards.audioText: CSN6202, Beijing roger. [Tell the controller that you have ice accumulation as a result of suspected de-icing equipment failure. Request descent below the freezing level.]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航6202，北京收到。【告知管制员你遇到积冰，除冰装置疑似故障。请求下降至结冰高度以下。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN6202, possible de-icing equipment failure, ice is building up. Request descent below freezing level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，南航6202，除冰装置似乎有问题，积冰严重。请求下降至结冰高度以下。

cards.audioText: CSN6202, roger descent to 6300m. Report if you still have emergency condition on this level?[Tell the controller this level should be sufficient and emergency conditions do not exist.]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航6202，收到，下降6300米。报告你是否在此高度还有紧急情况？【告知管制员这个高度足够了，不存在紧急状况。】
cards.referenceText: Descending to 6300m, negative emergency conditions, this level is sufficient, CSN6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到6300米，没有紧急状况，这个高度已经足够，南航6202。

cards.audioText: There may be a problem about flight control system, request return to Beijing airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行操纵系统似乎有问题，请求返回北京机场。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN6202, request return to Beijing airport due possible problems with flight control system.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，南航6202，请求返回北京机场，飞行操纵系统似乎有问题。

cards.audioText: CSN6202, roger, confirm approach and landing normal? [Say no problem.]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航6202，收到，确定进近着陆正常？【回答没问题。】
cards.referenceText: Affirm, CSN6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，南航6202。

cards.audioText: CSN6202, turn right direct to GITUM, descend to and maintain 3600m.
cards.audioTextZh: 南航6202，右转直飞GITUM，下降保持3600米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right direct to GITUM, descend to and maintain 3600m, CSN6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞GITUM，下降保持3600米，南航6202。

cards.audioText: CSN6202, contact Approach 120.6.
Descend to 3600m. Contact Approach, tell him you have a further problem with your leading edge flap extension and believe it is because of the prior icing issue.
cards.audioTextZh: 下降3600米，联系进近，告知他前缘襟翼无法放下，应该是受之前的积冰影响。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CSN6202, descending to 3600m. We have a problem with our leading edge flap extension.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，南航6202，正下降至3600米。我们的前缘襟翼无法放下。

cards.audioText: CSN6202, Beijing Approach, roger, do you require any other assistance? [Tell Approach you have a micro-switch malfunction and will conduct a flapless landing and request runway 36R.]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航6202，北京进近，收到，是否需要其它援助？【告知进近微动电门故障，准备实施无襟翼着陆，并请求降落在跑道36右。】
cards.referenceText: Due possible micro-switch malfunction, we'll be conducting a flapless landing and request runway 36R, CSN6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 由于微动电门似乎发生故障，我们准备实施无襟翼着陆，请求跑道36右，南航6202。

cards.audioText: CSN6202 roger, change of runway 36R, turn left heading 090, descend to and maintain 2700m on QNH 1013, information C.
cards.audioTextZh: 南航6202，收到，更换跑道36右，左转航向090，下降保持修正海压2700米保持，修正海压1013，通播C。
cards.referenceText: Runway 36R, turn left heading 090, descend to and maintain 2700m on QNH 1013, information C, CSN6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道36右，左转航向090，下降保持修正海压2700米，修正海压1013，通播C，南航6202。

cards.audioText: CSN6202, turn right heading 270, descend to 1800m.
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 270, descend to 1800m, CSN6202.

cards.audioText: CSN6202, the field is 11 miles away, report visual contact. [Tell the approach, you have the runway in sight.]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航6202，距离机场还有11海里，能见地面叫。【告诉进近，你可以看见跑道。】
cards.referenceText: Runway in sight, CSN6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 看到跑道了，南航6202。

cards.audioText: CSN6202, make visual approach 36R, turn final when ready.
cards.audioTextZh: 南航6202，目视进近跑道36右，准备好后转向五边。
cards.referenceText: Make visual approach 36R, turn final when ready, CSN6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 目视进近跑道36右，准备好后转向五边，南航6202。
